fee_notes:
This franchise uses a fixed Monthly Membership Fee in lieu of a traditional royalty (no percentage-of-revenue royalty). As of April 1, 2026, fees are: $1,465/month (Professional, Legacy, or Emeritus tier), $1,570/month (Certified tier), $1,780/month (Expert tier). New franchisees start at Professional tier. Fee may increase annually by ~5% (typically April), capped at $200/month ($2,400/year) per calendar year during initial term.

Brand Development Fund: currently does not exist; if established, initial fee capped at $100/month, increases capped at $100/month ($1,200/year) per calendar year.

Local/Regional Advertising Cooperative: currently does not exist; if established, total annual contributions capped at 1% of average gross session revenues.

Technology Fee: currently does not exist; if established, initial fee capped at $100/month, increases capped at $100/month ($1,200/year) per calendar year.

Warm Leads Fee (optional program): 50% of paid session fee for the Focus Day or first session, minimum $1,500, payable within 14 days after session.

Speaking Referral Fee: 25% of gross revenue from conference/third-party referrals, payable within 14 days.

Additional/Mandatory Remedial Training Fees: $995–$10,000 plus travel.

QCE Fee: $1,000 per additional QCE beyond those included in Monthly Membership Fee; late/cancellation fees apply.

Annual EOS Conference Fee: up to $2,500 for 2027 (eligibility-based, attendance optional).

Transfer Fee: $5,000.

Practice Management (optional): $195–$495/month based on number of active clients.

Firm Model – Monthly Slot Fee: $500/slot/month. Conversion Fee: $25,000 per Existing Implementer.

Additional email accounts: $18/month (2nd account), $25/month each (3+ accounts).

Interest on overdue amounts: lower of 1.5%/month or highest rate allowed by law.

ACH/Credit Card Administration Fees: up to $50/incident for declined/cancelled payments; up to $50 per account change; up to 4% of credit card charges.
raw_excerpt:
Monthly Membership Fee(2): As of April 1, 2026, Monthly Membership Fees are as follows: $1,465 for all franchisees designated in the "Professional", "Legacy" or "Emeritus" tier. $1,570 for all franchisees designated in the "Certified" tier. $1,780 for all franchisees designated in the "Expert" tier. Under the terms of the Franchise Agreement, we may increase the Monthly Membership Fees from time to time, but we may not increase these fees more than once in any calendar year and any incremental fee increase will not exceed $200 per month ($2,400 annually) in any calendar year during the initial term of your Franchise Agreement.

Brand Development Fund(3): Currently we do not have a brand marketing fund ("Brand Development Fund"). We may however establish a Brand Development Fund in the future, but we will limit the initial fee to no more than $100 per month, and will not increase the fee more than once in a calendar year and any incremental fee increase will not exceed $100 per month ($1,200 annually) in any calendar year during the initial term of your Franchise Agreement.

Local or Regional Advertising Cooperative and Special Marketing Programs(4): Currently we do not have any local or regional advertising cooperatives or other special advertising programs that require participation or contributions from franchisees. If we establish any cooperative advertising or other special marketing programs in the future, your contribution along with those from other franchisees will be determined at that time based on factors we deem appropriate. To be consistent with market standards, we would look to limit total annual contributions to no more than 1% of average gross session revenues.

Warm Leads Fee(5): 50% of the paid session fee for the Focus Day (or any other first session) provided for or on behalf of a Warm Lead, with a minimum of $1,500.

Speaking Referral Fee(6): 25% of gross revenue.

Technology Fee(7): Currently, we do not have a Technology Fee. We may establish a Technology Fee in the future, but we will limit the fee initially to no more than $100 per month.

Transfer Fee(10): $5,000.

Practice Management(14): Currently $195 - $495/month.

Monthly Slot Fee(15): $500 per Slot per month.

Conversion Fee(16): $25,000 per Existing Implementer.
